label: Customer Support Team
blurb: A Head of Customer Experience with support, help center, success and feedback
purpose: For any business with customers who have questions. The team drafts replies, turns repeat questions into help articles, checks in with customers at risk, and reports what customers are saying.

project.name: Customer Support
project.goal: Answer customers quickly and well, and fix the causes of repeat problems.

members.title: Head of Customer Experience

members.title: Support Specialist

focus: Draft replies to incoming questions, fastest-first for urgent ones.

members.title: Help Center Writer
members.name: Ingrid
focus: Write an article for every question asked three times.
